components.name: list
components.element:
<List filters={[
 <TextInput source="id" alwaysOn/>,
 <TransformInput expression="{parse: text => `Like('%${text}%')`, format: text => text ? text.replace(new RegExp(`.*%(.*)%.*`), '$1') : '', source}" source="title">
  <TextInput/>
 </TransformInput>,
 <TransformInput expression="{parse: text => `{name: '${text}'}`, format: text => text ? text.replace(new RegExp(`.*'(.*)'.*`), '$1') : '', choices: config.page.tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: tag})), source}" source="tags">
  <SelectInput/>
 </TransformInput>
]} exporter={false}>
 <Datagrid rowClick={false}>
  <FunctionField source="id" render={record =>
   <TransformField expression="{to: `/${id}`}" id={record.id}>
    <Link>{record.id}</Link>
   </TransformField>
  }/>
  <TextField source="title"/>
  <ArrayField source="tags">
   <SingleFieldList linkType={false}>
    <ChipField source="name" size="small"/>
   </SingleFieldList>
  </ArrayField>
  <EditButton/>
 </Datagrid>
</List>

components.element:
<ContentField resource="page" name="one" id={props.id}>

  <Parser/>

components.name: menu
components.element:
<List>
 <ContentField resource="page" name="menu">
  <Transform expression="[`/${menu.id}`, menu.title]">
   {(to, title) =>
    <Link to={to}>
     <ListItem>
      <ListItemText primary={title}/>
     </ListItem>
    </Link>
   }
  </Transform>
 </ContentField>
</List>
